data.name: Time Loop Nibiru
data.detailed_description:
You are not alone in this loop. You have yourself.

  • Uncover the Secrets of Nibiru
    In this world, knowledge is your ultimate weapon. Explore massive abandoned laboratories and the harsh alien landscapes of Nibiru. Study the environment, learn the rules of this universe, and use its laws to turn the tide against your enemies.

  • Cooperate with Your Past Selves
    Death is not the end; it’s a tactical advantage. Our unique Temporal Echoes system allows you to literally cooperate with your own past. Use the ghosts of your previous runs as human shields, distractions, or partners to solve complex spatial puzzles and flank hostiles.

  • Explore, Adapt, and Overcome
    Planet Nibiru is torn apart by a civil war between three factions, while an orbital Imperial cruiser looms above. Carefully map your route in true Metroidvania fashion, learn the exact timing of world events, and find hidden paths to proceed further.

  • Break the Loop
    Discover the true cause of the catastrophe. Only by connecting all the pieces of the conspiracy and trying different paths will you be able to unlock all possible endings and escape the cursed planet.

data.short_description: Your death is your greatest weapon. A sci-fi Metroidvania shooter where you are trapped in a time loop on the war-torn planet Nibiru. Explore a vast interconnected world, solve puzzles, and cooperate with the ghosts of your past lives to survive and escape.
